utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll stop by the repair drive later. If they’re short on any tools or supplies, I can ask around for them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be a big help, thanks. I’m gathering spare screws, duct tape, and any hand tools folks can lend, and I’ll bring everything over soon.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll swing by later and check what they still need. I’ll ask around for any extra tools or supplies if they’re short.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring the tools for the repair drive, and Rey can help with them and take a volunteer shift too. We can also have Rey sort the deliveries and keep the drop-off list updated.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That sounds good — I can handle the deliveries and keep the drop-off list updated, and I’ll take a volunteer shift too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks, Rey. I’ll gather the tools and bring them over, and we’ll keep Pia posted so everything gets there on time.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye on the supplies, so let me know what the group still needs. I can help gather whatever’s missing for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Cleo. We still need a few volunteers, some basic tools, and a clear start time and place—once that’s set, please let me know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Absolutely — I’ll watch for the missing pieces, and I’ll let Noah know to check what we still need. Once you’ve got the start time and place, send it my way and I’ll help gather the tools and supplies.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Faye — that’d really help. If you spot any calendar conflicts, let me know, and I’ll keep you posted on what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I will — I’ll check the school calendar and get back to you with the time and place for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks Faye — I appreciate it. I’ll keep you updated on the tools and supplies we still need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll let Mina, Gus, and Rey know as soon as the repair drive date is confirmed. Then we can line everything up on time.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help sort the donations when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Uli — I’ll keep you in the loop, and once the date is confirmed, I’ll let you know when to start sorting the donations.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Vik’s planning to stop by later and see what you still need. I’m also hearing Ira’s lining up a few more folks, so we should be in decent shape.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, I can help spread the word too. Just let me know once the date’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll let you know as soon as the date’s confirmed. Vik should also check what tools or supplies you’re still short on when they stop by.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Mina, I’m still mentioning the repair drive to folks while I’m out running errands. If you know anyone who needs a fix, send them my way and I’ll try to line them up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira — I will. I’m sorting flyers with Nell, and she’ll ask Hana about the date and let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Great, thanks. I’ll keep asking around today and see if I can line up a few more folks for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That helps a lot — if Gus can lend the tools and get any missing ones there on time, that takes some pressure off. And if Rey keeps the drop-off list updated, I can stay on top of the deliveries.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of who’s coming, and the drop-off spot is the community center parking lot by the side entrance. That should help keep the repairs moving smoothly.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, that side entrance should make the drop-offs easier to manage. I’ll keep an eye on the list and make sure nothing gets lost in the shuffle.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Sam’s helping with the repair drive, right? And Leo’s got the screwdriver set, zip ties, and a flashlight?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure who’s organizing it yet, but I can help sort tools or hand out flyers if needed. Mina and I are already sorting the flyers by street.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right, so Sam is helping, and Leo’s bringing the screwdriver set, zip ties, and a flashlight, correct?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Gus can bring a few tools, and Cleo can help gather what we need. Oren’s sorting donations and carrying a few things, and Ira’s been spreading the word all day.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can help with the first few tasks too. And Dane can help spread the word if you still need another hand.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’d be great, Bo — more hands will help a lot. I’ll keep Dane in mind if we need another person spreading the word.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, I’m glad folks are talking about the repair drive. I’ll keep spreading the word and get Dane involved too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — Dane can jump in wherever needed. I’ll bring the screwdriver set, zip ties, and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Perfect, Leo — that’s a big help. I’ll let Opal know you’re coming and keep nudging folks to join us.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect — Sunday at the community center it is. I’ll bring the sign-up sheet and walk Bo through the first few sign-ups.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’ll round up a few volunteers and bring the spare tools I’ve got for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, Mara — that covers a big piece. I’ll see you Sunday at the community center, and if Dane or Sam needs anything, we can slot them in where it helps most.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check the school calendar and get back to you with the time and place for the repair drive. I’ll also help spread the word once I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Faye — I’m glad you’re checking. Mina and I can keep sorting the flyers by street, and I can hand some out once you have the details.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Sounds good — I’ll check the school calendar and let you know the time and place as soon as I can. Thanks for sorting the flyers; I’ll help spread the word once I have the details.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Great — I’ve got the sign-up sheet, and I’ll walk Bo through the first few sign-ups. Sunday at the community center should work well for everyone.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Good, that helps. If Gus can bring the tools on time and Rey keeps the drop-off list updated, I can stay on top of the logistics.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That sounds perfect, Pia — once Gus has the tools there on time and Rey keeps the drop-off list current, the rest should stay smooth. I’ll keep things moving on my end and check in if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Leo’s got the screwdriver set, zip ties, and flashlight, right? And Sam and Oren are both helping too?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, that’s right — Leo’s got the tools, and Sam and Oren are in too. I’m still mentioning the repair drive to folks I run into today, trying to line up a few more people.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Okay, and Rosa’s bringing the sign-up sheet and helping Bo with the first few sign-ups, right?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help sort the donations for the repair drive. Just let me know when and where to show up.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be great — it’s later, and I’m planning to stop by then. I’ll ask what tools or supplies they’re short on, and I can ask around if we need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Vik. I’ll be there later and help sort whatever comes in.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll gather the spare screws, duct tape, and any hand tools folks can lend, then bring everything over soon.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help spread the word and pull in a few more neighbors. Just let me know once the date’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: That’d be a big help, Dane — I’ll let you know as soon as the date’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m keeping an eye on the supplies for the repair drive, and I can help gather whatever we still need. Sam, Noah, and Gus are all pitching in too.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Cleo. I’m bringing a screwdriver set, zip ties, and a flashlight, and Oren will watch for my message and help if he can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’s great, Leo — I’ll keep track of what’s still missing and let you know. Once Noah checks the gaps, we should have a better idea of what to bring.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: The drop-off spot is the community center parking lot by the side entrance. I’m keeping track of who’s coming, too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that helps. Have you heard the repair drive date yet?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Not yet — I’m still waiting to hear the date. I’ll let you know as soon as I do.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yep, I’m keeping an eye out for Leo’s message and I’ll jump in where I can. Sam’s bringing the screws, duct tape, and tools soon, right?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yep — Gus is bringing the tools and should cover anything missing on time. I can sort the deliveries and keep the drop-off list updated too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh good, that helps a lot. I’ll keep an eye out for Leo’s message and help sort or carry whatever needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can bring the tools and help make sure anything missing gets there on time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, that should really help. Pia can handle the logistics, and Rey’s keeping the drop-off list updated too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for any missing tools and get them over there on time.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I’ll check what the repair drive is still missing and let Cleo know. If I spot anything it needs, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Noah — I’ve got a few volunteers and my spare tools lined up already. Let me know what’s still missing, and I’ll help fill the gaps.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, I’ll take a look and see what’s still needed. I might miss a thing or two, but I’ll let you know as soon as I find it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Nell’s helping with the flyers, and Rey can bring tools and take a volunteer shift. We still need a few more volunteers and a set start time before it’s ready.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great — I’ll keep spreading the word and ask Dane to help too. Once we lock in a start time, we’ll be in good shape.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, that’s the last piece I needed. If you can set the start time, I’ll keep track of the volunteers and tools.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’ll confirm the repair drive date first, then I’ll let Mina, Gus, and Rey know so everything can be lined up on time.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I can help with the first few tasks. Just let me know when the date’s set.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Bo — I’ll do that as soon as the date is confirmed.
